audit_status.source_base: Hebrew 1 Chronicles / Divrei Hayamim Aleph postexilic Jerusalem inhabitants, priests, Levites, gatekeepers, service workers, and repeated Saul genealogy, first-pass restored draft with public-domain scaffold; later witness audit required
audit_status.review_note: Reviewed for exile blame, return and resettlement, temple servants/Nethinim, tribal inclusion, priestly and Levitical hierarchy, gatekeeping and treasury work, food and craft labor, day-and-night service, hereditary office, and repetition of Saul's line.

verses.restored: All Israel was enrolled by genealogy; look, they were written in scroll of kings of Israel. Judah was carried away to Babylon for unfaithfulness, in narrator's theology.

familiar.text: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.

modern.text: So all Israel was recorded in the genealogies written in the Book of the Kings of Israel. But Judah was exiled to Babylon because of their unfaithfulness.

original.text: וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הִתְיַחְשׂ֔וּ וְהִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל סֵ֖פֶר מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וִיהוּדָ֛ה הָגְל֥וּ לְבָבֶ֖ל בְּמַעֲלָֽם

verses.restored: First inhabitants who lived again in their possessions and cities were Israelites, priests, Levites, and temple servants.

familiar.text: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.

modern.text: Now the first to resettle their own property in their cities were Israelites, priests, Levites, and temple servants.

original.text: וְהַיּוֹשְׁבִים֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּאֲחֻזָּתָ֖ם בְּעָרֵיהֶ֑ם יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים הַלְוִיִּ֖ם וְהַנְּתִינִֽים

verses.restored: In Jerusalem lived some from Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh:

familiar.text: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;

modern.text: These were some of the descendants of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh who lived in Jerusalem:

original.text: וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ יָשְׁב֔וּ מִן בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וּמִן בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן וּמִן בְּנֵ֥י אֶפְרַ֖יִם וּמְנַשֶּֽׁה

verses.restored: Uthai son of Ammihud son of Omri son of Imri son of Bani, from descendants of Perez son of Judah.

familiar.text: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.

modern.text: Uthai son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, a descendant of Perez son of Judah.

original.text: עוּתַ֨י בֶּן עַמִּיה֤וּד בֶּן עָמְרִי֙ בֶּן אִמְרִ֣י בֶן בנימן בְּנֵי פֶ֖רֶץ בֶּן יְהוּדָֽה

verses.restored: From Shilonites: Asaiah firstborn and his sons.

familiar.text: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.

modern.text: From the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

original.text: וּמִן הַשִּׁ֣ילוֹנִ֔י עֲשָׂיָ֥ה הַבְּכ֖וֹר וּבָנָֽיו

verses.restored: From sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their relatives—six hundred ninety.

familiar.text: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.

modern.text: From the Zerahites: Jeuel and 690 relatives.

original.text: וּמִן בְּנֵי זֶ֖רַח יְעוּאֵ֑ל וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם שֵׁשׁ מֵא֥וֹת וְתִשְׁעִֽים

verses.restored: From sons of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam son of Hodaviah son of Hassenuah,

familiar.text: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,

modern.text: From the Benjamites: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

original.text: וּמִן בְּנֵ֖י בִּנְיָמִ֑ן סַלּוּא֙ בֶּן מְשֻׁלָּ֔ם בֶּן הוֹדַוְיָ֖ה בֶּן הַסְּנֻאָֽה

verses.restored: Ibneiah son of Jeroham, Elah son of Uzzi son of Michri, and Meshullam son of Shephatiah son of Reuel son of Ibnijah.

familiar.text: And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

modern.text: Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; Meshullam son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

original.text: וְיִבְנְיָה֙ בֶּן יְרֹחָ֔ם וְאֵלָ֥ה בֶן עֻזִּ֖י בֶּן מִכְרִ֑י וּמְשֻׁלָּם֙ בֶּן שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה בֶּן רְעוּאֵ֖ל בֶּן יִבְנִיָּֽה

verses.restored: Their relatives according to generations were nine hundred fifty-six. All these were heads of ancestral houses.

familiar.text: And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.

modern.text: and 956 of their relatives according to their genealogy. All these men were heads of their families.

original.text: וַאֲחֵיהֶם֙ לְתֹ֣לְדוֹתָ֔ם תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֑ה כָּל אֵ֣לֶּה אֲנָשִׁ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֥י אָב֖וֹת לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: From priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,

familiar.text: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,

modern.text: From the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, and Jachin;

original.text: וּמִן הַֽכֹּהֲנִ֑ים יְדַֽעְיָ֥ה וִיהוֹיָרִ֖יב וְיָכִֽין

verses.restored: Azariah son of Hilkiah son of Meshullam son of Zadok son of Meraioth son of Ahitub, ruler/official of house of Divine,

familiar.text: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;

modern.text: Azariah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the chief official of God’s temple;

original.text: וַעֲזַרְיָ֨ה בֶן חִלְקִיָּ֜ה בֶּן מְשֻׁלָּ֣ם בֶּן צָד֗וֹק בֶּן מְרָיוֹת֙ בֶּן אֲחִיט֔וּב נְגִ֖יד בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: Adaiah son of Jeroham son of Pashhur son of Malchijah, and Maasai son of Adiel son of Jahzerah son of Meshullam son of Meshillemith son of Immer.

familiar.text: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

modern.text: Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

original.text: וַעֲדָיָה֙ בֶּן יְרֹחָ֔ם בֶּן פַּשְׁח֖וּר בֶּן מַלְכִּיָּ֑ה וּמַעְשַׂ֨י בֶּן עֲדִיאֵ֧ל בֶּן יַחְזֵ֛רָה בֶּן מְשֻׁלָּ֥ם בֶּן מְשִׁלֵּמִ֖ית בֶּן אִמֵּֽר

verses.restored: Their relatives, heads of ancestral houses, were one thousand seven hundred sixty, capable people for work of service of house of Divine.

familiar.text: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.

modern.text: and 1,760 of their relatives, the heads of their families, able men for the work of the service of the house of God.

original.text: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֗ם רָאשִׁים֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתָ֔ם אֶ֕לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְשִׁשִּׁ֑ים גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חֵ֔יל מְלֶ֖אכֶת עֲבוֹדַ֥ת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: From Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub son of Azrikam son of Hashabiah, from descendants of Merari;

familiar.text: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

modern.text: From the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, a descendant of Merari;

original.text: וּמִֽן הַלְוִיִּ֑ם שְׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה בֶן חַשּׁ֛וּב בֶּן עַזְרִיקָ֥ם בֶּן חֲשַׁבְיָ֖ה מִן בְּנֵ֥י מְרָרִֽי

verses.restored: Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah son of Mica son of Zichri son of Asaph;

familiar.text: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;

modern.text: Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;

original.text: וּבַקְבַּקַּ֥ר חֶ֖רֶשׁ וְגָלָ֑ל וּמַתַּנְיָה֙ בֶּן מִיכָ֔א בֶּן זִכְרִ֖י בֶּן אָסָֽף

verses.restored: Obadiah son of Shemaiah son of Galal son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah son of Asa son of Elkanah, who lived in villages of Netophathites.

familiar.text: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.

modern.text: Obadiah son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

original.text: וְעֹבַדְיָה֙ בֶּֽן שְׁמַֽעְיָ֔ה בֶּן גָּלָ֖ל בֶּן יְדוּת֑וּן וּבֶרֶכְיָ֤ה בֶן אָסָא֙ בֶּן אֶלְקָנָ֔ה הַיּוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחַצְרֵ֥י נְטוֹפָתִֽי

verses.restored: Gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives; Shallum was chief.

familiar.text: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;

modern.text: These were the gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives. Shallum was their chief;

original.text: וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִים֙ שַׁלּ֣וּם וְעַקּ֔וּב וְטַלְמֹ֖ן וַאֲחִימָ֑ן וַאֲחִיהֶ֥ם שַׁלּ֖וּם הָרֹֽאשׁ

verses.restored: Until then he served at king's gate eastward. They were gatekeepers in camps/divisions of Levites.

familiar.text: Who hitherto waited in the king’s gate eastward: they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi.

modern.text: he was previously stationed at the King’s Gate on the east side. These were the gatekeepers from the camp of the Levites.

original.text: וְֽעַד הֵ֔נָּה בְּשַׁ֥עַר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ מִזְרָ֑חָה הֵ֚מָּה הַשֹּׁ֣עֲרִ֔ים לְמַחֲנ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי

verses.restored: Shallum son of Kore son of Ebiasaph son of Korah and relatives of his ancestral house, Korahites, were over service work, guarding thresholds of tent; their ancestors had guarded entrance of camp of YHWH.

familiar.text: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the host of the LORD, were keepers of the entry.

modern.text: Shallum son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his relatives from the Korahites were assigned to guard the thresholds of the Tent, just as their fathers had been assigned to guard the entrance to the dwelling of the LORD.

original.text: וְשַׁלּ֣וּם בֶּן ק֠וֹרֵא בֶּן אֶבְיָסָ֨ף בֶּן קֹ֜רַח וְֽאֶחָ֧יו לְבֵית אָבִ֣יו הַקָּרְחִ֗ים עַ֚ל מְלֶ֣אכֶת הָעֲבוֹדָ֔ה שֹׁמְרֵ֥י הַסִּפִּ֖ים לָאֹ֑הֶל וַאֲבֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ עַל מַחֲנֵ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה שֹׁמְרֵ֖י הַמָּבֽוֹא

verses.restored: Phinehas son of Eleazar had been leader over them in past, and YHWH was with him.

familiar.text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.

modern.text: In earlier times Phinehas son of Eleazar had been in charge of the gatekeepers, and the LORD was with him.

original.text: וּפִֽינְחָ֣ס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָ֗ר נָגִ֨יד הָיָ֧ה עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם לְפָנִ֖ים יְהוָ֥ה עִמּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper at entrance of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

modern.text: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was the gatekeeper at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: זְכַרְיָה֙ בֶּ֣ן מְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֔ה שֹׁעֵ֥ר פֶּ֖תַח לְאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: All chosen as gatekeepers at thresholds were two hundred twelve. They were enrolled by genealogy in villages; David and Samuel the seer established them in trusted office.

familiar.text: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.

modern.text: The number of those chosen to be gatekeepers at the thresholds was 212. They were registered by genealogy in their villages. David and Samuel the seer had appointed them to their positions of trust.

original.text: כֻּלָּ֤ם הַבְּרוּרִים֙ לְשֹׁעֲרִ֣ים בַּסִּפִּ֔ים מָאתַ֖יִם וּשְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר הֵ֤מָּה בְחַצְרֵיהֶם֙ הִתְיַחְשָׂ֔ם הֵ֣מָּה יִסַּ֥ד דָּוִ֛יד וּשְׁמוּאֵ֥ל הָרֹאֶ֖ה בֶּאֱמוּנָתָֽם

verses.restored: They and their descendants had oversight of gates of house of YHWH, the tent-house, by watches.

familiar.text: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the LORD, namely, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.

modern.text: So they and their descendants were assigned to guard the gates of the house of the LORD—the house called the Tent.

original.text: וְהֵ֨ם וּבְנֵיהֶ֜ם עַל הַשְּׁעָרִ֧ים לְבֵית יְהוָ֛ה לְבֵ֥ית הָאֹ֖הֶל לְמִשְׁמָרֽוֹת

verses.restored: Gatekeepers were on four sides: east, west, north, and south.

familiar.text: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.

modern.text: The gatekeepers were stationed on the four sides: east, west, north, and south.

original.text: לְאַרְבַּ֣ע רוּח֔וֹת יִהְי֖וּ הַשֹּׁעֲרִ֑ים מִזְרָ֥ח יָ֖מָּה צָפ֥וֹנָה וָנֶֽגְבָּה

verses.restored: Their relatives in villages came at intervals for seven days to serve with them.

familiar.text: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.

modern.text: Their relatives came from their villages at fixed times to serve with them for seven-day periods.

original.text: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֨ם בְּחַצְרֵיהֶ֜ם לָב֨וֹא לְשִׁבְעַ֧ת הַיָּמִ֛ים מֵעֵ֥ת אֶל עֵ֖ת עִם אֵֽלֶּה

verses.restored: Four chief gatekeepers, Levites, were in trusted office over chambers and treasuries of house of Divine.

familiar.text: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.

modern.text: But the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were entrusted with the rooms and the treasuries of the house of God.

original.text: כִּ֣י בֶאֱמוּנָ֞ה הֵ֗מָּה אַרְבַּ֨עַת֙ גִּבֹּרֵ֣י הַשֹּׁעֲרִ֔ים הֵ֖ם הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְהָיוּ֙ עַל הַלְּשָׁכ֔וֹת וְעַ֥ל הָאֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: They lodged around house of Divine because watch was upon them, and opening it morning by morning was their responsibility.

familiar.text: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.

modern.text: They would spend the night stationed around the house of God, because they were responsible for guarding it and opening it every morning.

original.text: וּסְבִיב֥וֹת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים יָלִ֑ינוּ כִּֽי עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת וְהֵ֥ם עַל הַמַּפְתֵּ֖חַ וְלַבֹּ֥קֶר לַבֹּֽקֶר

verses.restored: Some were responsible for vessels of service, bringing them in and out by count.

familiar.text: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.

modern.text: Some of them were in charge of the articles used in worship, to count them whenever they were brought in or taken out.

original.text: וּמֵהֶ֖ם עַל כְּלֵ֣י הָעֲבוֹדָ֑ה כִּֽי בְמִסְפָּ֣ר יְבִיא֔וּם וּבְמִסְפָּ֖ר יוֹצִיאֽוּם

verses.restored: Some were appointed over furniture, all sanctuary vessels, fine flour, wine, oil, frankincense, and spices.

familiar.text: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.

modern.text: Others were put in charge of the furnishings and other articles of the sanctuary, as well as the fine flour, wine, oil, frankincense, and spices.

original.text: וּמֵהֶ֗ם מְמֻנִּים֙ עַל הַכֵּלִ֔ים וְעַ֖ל כָּל כְּלֵ֣י הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְעַל הַסֹּ֨לֶת֙ וְהַיַּ֣יִן וְהַשֶּׁ֔מֶן וְהַלְּבוֹנָ֖ה וְהַבְּשָׂמִֽים

verses.restored: Some sons of priests compounded ointment of spices.

familiar.text: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.

modern.text: And some of the sons of the priests mixed the spices.

original.text: וּמִן בְּנֵי֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים רֹקְחֵ֥י הַמִּרְקַ֖חַת לַבְּשָׂמִֽים

verses.restored: Mattithiah, a Levite, firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had trusted responsibility over things baked in pans.

familiar.text: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.

modern.text: A Levite named Mattithiah, the firstborn son of Shallum the Korahite, was entrusted with baking the bread.

original.text: וּמַתִּתְיָה֙ מִן הַלְוִיִּ֔ם ה֥וּא הַבְּכ֖וֹר לְשַׁלֻּ֣ם הַקָּרְחִ֑י בֶּאֱמוּנָ֕ה עַ֖ל מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הַחֲבִתִּֽים

verses.restored: Some of their Kohathite relatives were over bread of presence, preparing it Sabbath by Sabbath.

familiar.text: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.

modern.text: Some of their Kohathite brothers were responsible for preparing the rows of the showbread every Sabbath.

original.text: וּמִן בְּנֵ֧י הַקְּהָתִ֛י מִן אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם עַל לֶ֣חֶם הַֽמַּעֲרָ֑כֶת לְהָכִ֖ין שַׁבַּ֥ת שַׁבָּֽת

verses.restored: These were singers, heads of Levite ancestral houses, living in chambers and free from other duties, because they were engaged in work day and night.

familiar.text: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.

modern.text: Those who were musicians, the heads of Levite families, stayed in the temple chambers and were exempt from other duties because they were on duty day and night.

original.text: וְאֵ֣לֶּה הַ֠מְשֹׁרְרִים רָאשֵׁ֨י אָב֧וֹת לַלְוִיִּ֛ם בַּלְּשָׁכֹ֖ת פטירים כִּֽי יוֹמָ֥ם וָלַ֛יְלָה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם בַּמְּלָאכָֽה

modern.text: All these were heads of Levite families, chiefs according to their genealogies, and they lived in Jerusalem. The Descendants of Saul

modern.text: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maacah.

original.text: וְאָחָז֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת יַעְרָ֔ה וְיַעְרָ֗ה הוֹלִ֛יד אֶת עָלֶ֥מֶת וְאֶת עַזְמָ֖וֶת וְאֶת זִמְרִ֑י וְזִמְרִ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת מוֹצָֽא

original.text: וּמוֹצָ֖א הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת בִּנְעָ֑א וּרְפָיָ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ אֶלְעָשָׂ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ אָצֵ֥ל בְּנֽוֹ

original.text: וּלְאָצֵל֮ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה בָנִים֒ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֗ם עַזְרִיקָ֥ם בֹּ֨כְרוּ֙ וְיִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל וּשְׁעַרְיָ֔ה וְעֹבַדְיָ֖ה וְחָנָ֑ן אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י אָצַֽל

translation_notes: The opening attributes exile to unfaithfulness, but Babylonian deportation remains imperial violence suffered by civilians, workers, children, and later generations.
Returnees are not the only legitimate inhabitants of the land; postexilic resettlement must not erase people who remained or other communities living there.
Nethinim/temple servants may reflect subordinated or inherited service status. Sacred service must not conceal coerced labor or caste.
Ephraim and Manasseh are represented in Jerusalem, complicating simplistic claims that northern Israel disappeared completely.
Gatekeepers, inventory workers, cooks, spice compounders, bakers, singers, and night workers are skilled religious labor, not background help.
Hereditary trusted office does not guarantee trustworthiness or remove accountability and safeguarding requirements.
Day-and-night service should not justify exploitative schedules, sleep deprivation, or unpaid religious labor.
The repeated Saul genealogy preserves Esh-baal and Merib-baal name forms without shame; disability stigma and polemical renaming are rejected.
Chronicles and Nehemiah contain differing names and counts for postexilic residents and require source audit.
safety_note: Do not blame exiles for empire, erase people who remained in the land, defend hereditary temple servitude, exploit religious workers, or treat genealogical enrollment as citizenship purity. Sacred institutions owe safety, rest, compensation, and dignity to every worker.
